now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Ladypool comes with the Deadpool variants Cassandra Nova summons to stall Wade and Logan, and they gun down Nicepool. Logan cuts her down in the brawl, but she heals and joins the variants cheering Peter as Wade and Logan slip away.

changes.evidence: The record describes the Deadpool variants' attack on Wade, Logan and Nicepool after Cassandra Nova sends them through a portal to Earth-10005 (Wikipedia plot: 'follows Logan and Wade to Earth-10005... summons an army of Deadpool variants, who kill Nicepool'). The fight is in Earth-10005's New York City, near the Time Ripper at the TVA's 24th Street Station post, not in the Void (fandom Attack on Earth-10005: place = New York City; Ladypool page: Nova 'sent Ladypool and the Deadpool Corps to Earth-10005').

now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Cassandra Nova summons a crowd of Deadpool variants to stall Wade and Logan in Wade's world, and they gun down Nicepool. Wade and Logan cut through them, but the variants heal, and stop fighting only to cheer for Peter.
cases: ST-115 The Time Ripper Crisis (Deadpool & Wolverine)

changes.evidence: The variants' fight with Wade and Logan (Nicepool's death, Peter's arrival) takes place in Earth-10005's New York City, near the Time Ripper set up at the 24th Street Station TVA post. North Dakota is only where Logan's grave is, earlier in the film (fandom Attack on Earth-10005: place = New York City; 24th Street Station: 'subway station located in New York City').
